hints.title: English Representation Conversion
hints.text: Convert the integer into its standard English lowercase word representation without spaces.

hints.title: Character Frequency Counting
hints.text: Iterate through each character in the converted string and increment its occurrence count.

hints.title: Parity Filtering
hints.text: Count how many unique characters have an odd total occurrence count.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: L: length of English word string (L <= 30)
complexity.notes: Constant time word construction and frequency calculation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Number ranges are small, so direct simulation is ideal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed English numeral lookup tables avoid complex dynamic rules.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accurately implement number-to-words conversion and tally odd frequencies.
